text:
kai: starting deploy for llm-router v3.0.0 in the midnight change window. major tokenizer refactor behind flag `llmroute_token_v3`. rollout plan: canary -> 3% (10m) -> 12% (20m) -> 40% next window. release notes draft: https://redwood.internal/release/llm-router-v3.0.0 :tada:

deploy-bot: Automated: deploy initiated service=llm-router version=v3.0.0 by kai. Canary stage active. Manual approvals required for prod ramps.

natalie: holdpoint: keep 3% for full 10m. gating: semantic match > 99%, tokenization parity > 99.5%, p95 delta < 120ms. If tokenization parity < 99% or semantic match drops > 1% -> pause and pin back.

kai: note: manifest includes `model_pin = \"v3.0-token\"` for cohorts on flag=true. We'll unpin after 24h stable.

deploy-bot: Flag update: `llmroute_token_v3` -> 3% prod cohorts (QA override 100%) by kai.

colin: internal canary smoke (6m): semantic match 99.3%, token parity 99.6%, p95 +30ms. all good so far.

sre-oncall: infra watch: small jitter on router-batchers but nothing critical. setting rollback thresholds in runbook: token_parity < 99% OR semantic_match < 98.5% OR p95 > 300ms -> auto-disable flag and pin to v2.9-stable. disable CLI: ```/deploybot flag disable llmroute_token_v3``` or via Console: https://redwood.internal/flags/llmroute_token_v3

ops-bot: Runbook reminder: if tokenization parity dips we have two paths: 1) pause ramp and capture eval trace dumps; 2) immediate disable if visible user regressions. Commands: ```/deploybot flag set llmroute_token_v3 0``` to zero percent, or full disable. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/token-refactor-rollback

kai: scheduling ramp to 12% at +15m if gates hold. /approve required.

deploy-bot: Scheduled action pending: ramp `llmroute_token_v3` -> 12% at +15m (manual approval required).

natalie: /approve ramp to 12% (manual ack).

deploy-bot: Action executed: `llmroute_token_v3` -> 12% by kai at 00:14 UTC.

colin: post-ramp (4m): semantic match 98.9%, token parity 99.1%, p95 = +85ms. token parity dropped a touch under natalie's preferred gate (99.5). I'm attaching quick diff sample (link): https://redwood.internal/evals/v3-token-diff

natalie: seeing the parity dip too. Not yet catastrophic but below target. recommend PAUSE the next scheduled ramp and gather a few more traces. If parity < 99% on aggregated 5m window we should rollback.

sre-oncall: marking an alert in the runbook. We'll hold for 10m and watch. Auto-disable still in place if thresholds breached.

kai: executing manual pause: canceling future scheduled 40% ramp and setting `llmroute_token_v3` -> 6% to slow the change and get more signal.

deploy-bot: Action executed: `llmroute_token_v3` -> 6% by kai. Scheduled 40% ramp cancelled.

colin: updated metrics (6m): semantic match stabilizing at 99.0%, token parity 98.8% aggregated over 5m window. This crosses the rollback threshold in the runbook.

natalie: per runbook, token_parity < 99% AND semantic match < 99% => immediate mitigation. I'm recommending pin-back to v2.9-stable and full disable of the flag to avoid risk.

sre-oncall: concur. initiating fast-disable and pin-back.

kai: executing rollback now.

deploy-bot: Automated action: `llmroute_token_v3` disabled by kai. Configuration set: `route.model_pin = \"v2.9-stable\"` by kai. Command history: ```/deploybot flag disable llmroute_token_v3; /deploybot config set route.model_pin v2.9-stable```

colin: post-rollback: semantic match returned to 99.7%, token parity 99.9%, p95 back to baseline. No user-visible regressions reported.

natalie: updating release notes: "v3.0.0 tokenization refactor paused and rolled back from 12% due to token parity drift. Pinning to v2.9-stable and follow-up debugging planned. See runbook and attached eval traces."

kai: filing root-cause ticket and will reopen a follow-up thread once we have a patch. thanks everyone for quick response. :white_check_mark:
